rule.G1: for k in 2,3,4: every planned budget (0.5, 0.25, min) gives per-micro-batch losses (forward) and nonzero LoRA grads (backward) torch.equal to the all-pinned L2L AND to GA; references reproducible (GA vs GA, pinned vs pinned), else the --deterministic rerun; the corrupted-spill-read control's grads must DIFFER, else no verdict
rule.G2: every arm: the store holds exactly the plan's bytes (power-of-two pinned blocks, rings at chunk+4096) and <= its budget; CUDA host allocator peak during the timed steps minus its baseline before the store <= the activation budget; with a declared host total, the process peak RSS <= that total
rule.G3: cleanup: Ctrl-C mid-backward, exception mid-forward and ENOSPC mid-step each raise their named error, leave no spill file, no spill thread, and return the host allocator to its baseline; ENOSPC names SPILL_ENOSPC with the arithmetic; and no arm leaves a spill file
rule.G4: ram_k2_half and ram_k4_half: mean per-block step-time overhead of B (spill) over A (all pinned), two-sided 95% t interval: pass if its upper bound < 10%, fail if its lower bound >= 10%, else no verdict
rule.G5: disk_k4_same_drive: weight read GB/s while busy, B (spill on the weights' drive) over A (no spill), per-block ratio, 95% t interval: pass (no interference past 10%) if lower bound >= 0.9, fail if upper bound < 0.9, else no verdict
rule.V1: required F1 checks (suspend, power, foreign_reads) ok on every arm a gate reads; a block with a void arm is replaced (METHOD.md), an unknown one removes the gate
rule.V2: spill volume scope local or virtual, never tmpfs/overlay/network; unbuffered round trip ok; every spilling arm's store is direct
rule.V3: device cuda; a CPU pilot never gets a verdict
rule.V4: A and B of a block train on the same token rows (ids fingerprint)
rule.V5: finite losses on every timed step
rule.V6: the plan happened: budget '1' spills nothing; any other budget spills > 0 layers and writes and reads exactly spill_file_bytes per step
rule.V7: blocks: the F1 repeats rule has no block left to add (blocks_to_add == 0)
rule.V8: disk-tier arms: the weight source reads with direct I/O
rule.V9: disk_k4_same_drive: every spilling arm's OS placement records (resolved path, mount, whole physical disk) show the spill file and the weight shards on one physical disk; unknown placement removes G5
rule.order: A-B-B-A blocks, fresh process per arm, comparisons in the order listed
rule.hidden: informational: overhead upper bound <= 5% is 'hidden'; the hidden share of spill I/O is 1 - (put+get wait)/(write+read busy)
